name: payments-scheduler-extend-yarn
description: Yarn-only Foundry-aware target validation after the DCA Explainer extension. Named install allows fingerprint skip across attempts. Uses next:lint + foundry:compile + next:build (root yarn lint hits known prettier noise in foundry scripts-js).

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install Next.js and Foundry workspaces with Yarn (pilot is yarn-only).

commands.name: compile
commands.purpose: Compile Foundry contracts (HSS/ScheduledVault) to confirm the Solidity workspace stays healthy.
